locked.message: You can add {{name}} as a friend once one of you has matched with the other in Daily Matches and you've completed an Outing together.
locked.formerMessage: You and {{name}} were friends before. To be friends again, {{name}} needs to come up in your daily matches and you need to complete a new Outing together.

unfriend.message:
{{name}} will be removed from your friends, and neither of you will be able to open the other's profile.

You can't just add {{name}} back. To be friends again, {{name}} has to come up in your Daily Matches and you have to complete a new Outing together.

friendRequest.message: {{name}} will get an alert and can accept or deny it.
